$comment: L0 manifest — ships with coolstep. Do not hand-edit; create custom.json in ~/.config/coolstep/ instead.

community_pointers.trigger: MSI/Gigabyte/ASRock superio chip detected but no kernel driver
community_pointers.reason: Without nct6687 driver, motherboard fan RPMs are invisible to coolstep

commands.debian: apt install dkms && git clone https://github.com/Fred78290/nct6687d && cd nct6687d && make dkms/install
commands.fedora: dnf install dkms kernel-devel && git clone https://github.com/Fred78290/nct6687d && cd nct6687d && make dkms/install
commands.suse: zypper install dkms && git clone https://github.com/Fred78290/nct6687d

community_pointers.trigger: ASUS ROG/TUF laptop detected, asusctl absent
community_pointers.reason: asusctl exposes fan curves + platform profiles + AURA — coolstep's preferred ASUS actuator

commands.debian: git clone https://gitlab.com/asus-linux/asusctl && cargo build --release  # needs Rust
commands.fedora: dnf copr enable lukenukem/asus-linux && dnf install asusctl
commands.suse: zypper install asusctl  # may require Packman repo

community_pointers.reason: ryzenadj is the canonical AMD STAPM / fast-PPT / slow-PPT tuner

commands.debian: apt install build-essential cmake libpci-dev && git clone https://github.com/FlyGoat/RyzenAdj
commands.fedora: dnf install gcc cmake pciutils-devel && git clone https://github.com/FlyGoat/RyzenAdj

community_pointers.reason: Without perf events, coolstep can't read cache-miss / cycles -> no pre-thermal load signal

community_pointers.trigger: RAPL energy_uj present but root-only (CVE-2020-8694 mitigation)
community_pointers.reason: Without RAPL reads, coolstep can't compute actual CPU package power (W)

commands.arch: Add to systemd unit: AmbientCapabilities=CAP_SYS_ADMIN  (or run as root)

community_pointers.trigger: No bpftrace installed -- eBPF sched events unavailable
community_pointers.reason: bpftrace gives pre-load detection (10-50 ms earlier than /proc/stat)
Without ipmitool, server fan/inlet/exhaust telemetry is invisible (no BMC access)
